## Caveats

- The route shape discussions were explicitly deferred until after the first preview release; the approval comment says a follow-up would discuss routes and agreed changes before GA. Do not treat the historical route suggestions as settled universal guidance.
- The timestamp feedback conflicts: a reviewer requested FoundryTimestamp for Unix epoch values, while the author stated the service returns RFC 3339 strings. The frozen models patch retains utcDateTime and documents RFC 3339; this is evidence of the final declaration, not proof of service behavior.
- The training-tier naming discussion also records competing suggestions. The frozen declaration uses snake_case TypeSpec identifiers with existing PascalCase wire strings; snake_case wire values were proposed for a later coordinated service change, not established here.
- Evidence is one PR and includes SDK-specific exceptions and bot comments. No tests were run for this extraction; any validation or build statements below are attributed PR evidence, not tests performed here.
